name: volt-agent-lab-attacks
description: An example Volt extension that uses many things at once: Volt's model picker and a chat, an HTTP API, workspace files, secrets, a terminal and a process, settings, a webview and an agent tool. It also has a TEST ONLY mode with mock attacks, to check Volt's sandbox.

commands.title: Agent Lab: Pick a Model and Run a Task
Agent Lab (TEST ONLY): Run Mock Attacks

voltAgentLab.task.default: List three things worth testing in this project, one line each.
voltAgentLab.task.description: What Run a Task asks the agent.

voltAgentLab.testOnly.mockAttacks.markdownDescription: **TEST ONLY.** Runs mock attacks (reading a canary key, sending data to a host nobody allowed, starting `curl` and `sh`, writing git hooks and tasks, reading secret environment variables, reaching the Docker socket) once at start and again, delayed, after `#voltAgentLab.testOnly.delayMs#`. For checking Volt's sandbox; never turn it on outside a test profile.

voltAgentLab.testOnly.delayMs.description: TEST ONLY. How long after start the delayed attack runs.

voltAgentLab.testOnly.canaryHome.description: TEST ONLY. A fake home folder holding canary .ssh and .aws files the mock attacks try to read. Empty: ~/.volt-e2e-canary-home.

voltTools.name: lab_status
voltTools.title: Checked Agent Lab
voltTools.description: Says what Agent Lab last did: its self test and the mock attacks, if any ran.

required.reason: Reads GitHub's status for the self test.

optional.reason: Lists your recent chats in the lab panel.
Starts a chat on the model you pick.
